description: This file defines internal data structures, constants, and function prototypes for diff core operations in a version control system, including file specifications, file pairs, diff queues, and diff operations.

classes.name: diff_filespec
classes.description: Represents a single file (blob) in diff operations, including object ID, path, mode, and binary status.

classes.name: diff_filepair
classes.description: Represents a pair of files (preimage and postimage) involved in a diff, including status and rename/broken flags.

classes.name: diff_queue_struct
classes.description: A collection of filepairs, managing dynamic array of diff_filepair pointers.

classes.name: obj_order
classes.description: Represents an object with an original and current order for sorting purposes.

methods.name: alloc_filespec
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a diff_filespec structure.

methods.name: free_filespec
methods.description: Frees memory associated with a diff_filespec.

methods.name: fill_filespec
methods.description: Fills a diff_filespec with object ID, size, and mode.

methods.name: diff_queued_diff_prefetch
methods.description: Pre-fetches diff entries for a repository.

methods.name: diff_populate_filespec
methods.description: Populates a diff_filespec from repository data, with options.

methods.name: diff_free_filespec_data
methods.description: Frees data associated with a diff_filespec.

methods.name: diff_free_filespec_blob
methods.description: Frees blob data in a diff_filespec.

methods.name: diff_filespec_is_binary
methods.description: Checks if a diff_filespec is binary.

methods.name: diff_queue
methods.description: Adds a pair of diff_filespecs to a diff queue.

methods.name: diff_q
methods.description: Adds a diff_filepair to a diff queue.

methods.name: diffcore_break
methods.description: Performs diff operation to break files.

methods.name: diffcore_rename
methods.description: Performs rename detection in diff.

methods.name: diffcore_rename_extended
methods.description: Performs extended rename detection with additional parameters.

methods.name: diffcore_merge_broken
methods.description: Merges broken diff pairs.

methods.name: diffcore_pickaxe
methods.description: Performs pickaxe diff operation.

methods.name: diffcore_order
methods.description: Orders diff objects based on a specified order file.

methods.name: diffcore_rotate
methods.description: Rotates diff objects.

methods.name: order_objects
methods.description: Orders objects based on a specified order file and callback.

methods.name: diff_debug_filespec
methods.description: Debug function to print diff_filespec details (conditional).

methods.name: diff_debug_filepair
methods.description: Debug function to print diff_filepair details (conditional).

methods.name: diff_debug_queue
methods.description: Debug function to print diff queue details (conditional).

methods.name: diffcore_count_changes
methods.description: Counts changes between two diff_filespecs.

methods.name: diff_add_if_missing
methods.description: Adds missing objects to fetch list if referenced in diff_filespec.
